modelingNotes: Exact order is S201M-C4: one pole, C characteristic, rated current 4 A. IEC/EN 60898-1: Un 230/400 V AC, Icn 10 kA, 50/60 Hz, C reference temperature 30 degrees C. IEC/EN 60947-2: one-pole Ue 230 V AC, Icu 15 kA and Ics 11.2 kA at this rated current. Conditional ratings are documentation, not an assigned supply voltage or coordination check.

Manufacturer S201 family diagram identifies terminals 1 and 2. Shared numbered endpoints encompass cable/busbar accommodation; no separate opening numbers are invented. Bare breaker only; accessory contacts/releases and external bonding are separate equipment.

Open contact state follows the catalog drawing, not the installed handle position. Contact metadata never creates continuity; no fixed link joins 1 and 2. Terminals are application-dependent and may remain unused in a spare device. Trip dynamics are not simulated.

connectionCoverage.notes: Both numbered electrical terminals of the bare single-pole breaker are represented. No neutral, PE, shield, communication or auxiliary contacts belong to this order. Each shared terminal includes its cable/busbar accommodation.
